Amazon's 2026 Labor Day mega sale is now live, with AirPods Pro 3 down by $50 and AirTag 2 holding at a record low of $20 each. But today's 9to5Toys midday flash's main event is Amazon's first-ever cash discounts on the all-new M6 Mac mini and M5 Pro Mac mini, plus the Apple iPhone Air MagSafe battery from $39, and the 44mm Apple Watch SE 3 at an all-time low of $200. Also featuring Anker Labor Day deals with up to 58% off starting today, Bose 2026 Labor Day deals with up to $320 off, and grab the new Apple Polishing Cloth via Prime shipping for $9 before it sells out. All the best deals below.

Amazon's 2026 Labor Day mega sale officially kicks off! Thousands of curated deals: Apple, Android, TVs, tech under $100, and more — starting from just $5.

One of the year's best Apple deals: the all-new 2026 AirTag 2 from just $20 each.

  • AirTag 2 $24 (was $29) — new all-time low.
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $80 (was $99) — new all-time low.
  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 (was $249).
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (was $549).
  • AirPods 4 $99 (was $129).

Amazon offers reservation discounts on the two most affordable all-new M6 Mac mini configurations.

After the Labor Day mega sale kicked off, Amazon seems really keen for everyone to reserve the M6 Mac mini — they've just slightly marked down the two most entry-level configurations. The discounts aren't huge, but this is pretty much the only legitimate channel right now to grab an all-new M6 mini at a discount. Grab that Apple Polishing Cloth while it's still in stock, shipped via Prime for $9.

Yesterday evening we spotted Amazon drop the MSRP on the entry-level 16GB/256GB model, and now the mid-tier 16GB/512GB model has joined the price cuts:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $880 (was $899).
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (was $1,099).
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,299.
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,669 (was $1,699).

With the new mini starting from $899, these are clearly modest discounts, but then again these machines haven't even officially launched yet (shipping starts September 22). If you're planning to reserve one without a trade-in, saving a bit on gas or coffee money doesn't hurt.

As of now, as expected, the all-new M6 Mac mini is still being sold at full price by other authorized Apple resellers and Apple itself. We haven't seen any discounts on the 24GB M6 or M5 Pro models yet — we'll keep watching.

The latest Midnight Apple Watch SE 3 hits an all-time low of $200 on Amazon.

Amazon's 2026 Labor Day sale is live, with the 44mm Apple Watch SE 3 down to $200 — an all-time low and arguably the best value current Apple Watch we've tracked to date.

Amazon now has the Midnight 44mm Apple Watch SE 3 down to $199.99 with shipping.

This $280 model is now nearly 30% off MSRP, a hefty $80 off.

  • Midnight 44mm Apple Watch SE 3 $200 (was $280).

Act fast: AirPods 4 available on Amazon Renewed for $80.

iPhone 17 Pro hits an all-time low on Amazon, up to $290 off (Premium Renewed).

On the eve of the iPhone 18 Pro launch, Amazon's iPhone 17 Pro has hit a brand-new all-time low. If you want to skip next month's premium pricing on the new Pro models, or simply don't want to wait another six months or more for refurbished units to appear, Amazon's top-quality Renewed iPhone 17 Pro is now $290 off with a one-year Amazon Renewed warranty.

Right now, the Amazon Renewed Premium standard listing is the best channel for picking up an iPhone 17 Pro. Apple's official refurbished store still doesn't carry this model — we're talking Amazon's highest-quality inventory with a one-year Amazon Renewed warranty and battery health above 90%, which is far from your typical refurbished fare.

The 512GB and 1TB models are now both at the lowest prices we've tracked:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,215 (new MSRP $1,499) — new all-time low.
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,215 (new MSRP $1,499) — new all-time low.
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,208 (new MSRP $1,499) — new all-time low.
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,166 (new MSRP $1,299) — new all-time low.
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,171 (new MSRP $1,299) — new all-time low.
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,170 (new MSRP $1,299) — new all-time low.

All the links above will take you to the legitimate Amazon Renewed Premium pages — watch out for third-party sellers.

I don't know about you, but I'm really going to miss the 17 Pro colorways — though I was really hoping for an all-black version. I might just hold onto mine for another year.

The 2026 new Apple Polishing Cloth is in stock on Amazon with $9 Prime shipping — grab it before it sells out.

Amazon's Anker Labor Day sale officially kicks off, up to 58% off! Chargers, power banks, Qi2.2 accessories and more from $12.

Beats USB-C braided short cable is super handy, hits an all-time low of $12 on Amazon.

Anker MagSafe Nano power bank is one of the best options, down to a yearly low of $49 (all colors).

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • Bose 2026 Labor Day sale officially kicks off, up to $320 off: QuietComfort headphones and earbuds, speakers and more.
  • Satechi's gorgeous Qi2 Onthego 2-in-1 wireless charger slashed to $48 (was $80).
  • Top up your iPhone and AirPods while working or gaming — this oversized desk pad is now $28.50 (was $65).
  • This built-in-cable Baseus 25,000mAh high-capacity power bank is down to $45 today (all-time low).
  • ECOVACS three LiDAR PRO robotic mowers enjoy Labor Day deals up to 67% off, from $999.
  • Beatbot solar-powered iSkim automatic pool surface cleaner down to $339, upgraded Ultra model $699.
  • Ring's latest Retinal 2K doorbell $50 off, 4K model also $50 off, plus more deals.
  • meross HomeKit smart plug turns one outlet into three independently controllable outlets, from $48.

Upgrade your TV for Grand Theft Auto 6 — Samsung, Hisense, Sony and more up to $1,100 off or more, from $144.

Ongoing: Anker's brand-new SmartTrack Find My wallet card, supports iOS or Android, hits an all-time low of $25 on Amazon.

Anker Prime power bank doubles as a wall charger: my favorite portable charger down to $70.

ecobee 2026 Labor Day sale officially kicks off: HomeKit thermostats, sensors and bundles up to $120 off.

ecobee officially launches 2026 Labor Day deals on Amazon, with HomeKit-compatible smart thermostats from $120, plus select sensor accessories and complete security bundles up to $120 off.

ecobee 2026 Labor Day deals.

While individual smart thermostat prices aren't quite lower than Prime Day, ecobee smart home products never see particularly deep discounts. Saving money anytime is worth noting, and these kinds of discounts almost only appear during seasonal mega sales:

  • Smart Thermostat Premium $230 (was $260).
  • Smart Thermostat Enhanced $170 (was $200).
  • Smart Thermostat Essential $120 (was $140).
  • Smart Doorbell Camera $130 (was $160).
  • SmartSensor for Rooms (2-pack) $80 (was $100).
  • SmartSensor for Doors & Windows $50 (was $80).

Amazon Devices 2026 Labor Day deals up to 40% off: Echo displays/speakers, Fire TV and more from $18.

Apple official Bumper case slashed to an all-time low, under $13 (68% off).

Update Aug 27: Black Apple iPhone Air Bumper is back in stock, down to $13.42 with Prime shipping — that's 34% off MSRP.

Heads up iPhone Air users, Apple's official Bumper case has hit an all-time low on Amazon, under $13 with Prime shipping.

Amazon now sells the official Apple iPhone Air Bumper from $12.64, with free shipping for Prime members or orders over $35.

The light blue version is under $13, an all-time low in Amazon's tracking, a whopping 68% off the $39 MSRP. Other colors are priced higher, and black is completely sold out — at this price, light blue could sell out fast too.

That's right, it's just a minimalist case that wraps around the edges of the device, but at this price it's an absolute steal for an official Apple case. It showcases your phone's design and offers decent protection for users who really only need a little coverage — though it only protects the edges, with no coverage for the screen or camera module.
